description: The first holding declaration with a disabled feature decides the conflict, regardless of caller list order.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features g
%conditions $.classes = A
%features f
%conditions $.classes = A
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
```
